name: Samanantar: Indic Parallel Corpora Collection
description: Samanantar is the largest publicly available parallel corpora collection for 11 Indic languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu) paired with English. Curated by AI4Bharat, the dataset aggregates 49.7 million sentence pairs, including newly mined web sentence pairs combined with existing repositories, serving as a landmark benchmark for Indian language machine translation.
